items.title: Williams-Sonoma (NYSE:WSM) Exceeds Q2 CY2026 Expectations
items.summary: Kitchenware and home goods retailer Williams-Sonoma (NYSE:WSM) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 6.7% year on year to $1.96 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.10 per share was 1.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
